now.title: Eternals
now.text: Gilgamesh says Odin gave him his secret brew recipe as thanks after the Eternals helped defeat Laufey's army at Tønsberg. He fought Laufey's army, not Laufey himself, and it is only told.
now.on_a_card_about_b: Gilgamesh and the Eternals helped defeat his army at Tønsberg.
now.on_b_card_about_a: An Eternal who helped Asgard defeat Laufey's army at Tønsberg.

changes.evidence: Laufey never appears in Eternals; he is only mentioned when Gilgamesh, cooking for the Eternals, says Odin gave him a secret brew recipe after the Eternals helped defeat Laufey's army at Tonsberg. The two never share a scene or deal with each other on screen: it is a story told about a battle where Gilgamesh fought the army, not Laufey (the stage text itself says so). Nothing implies they know each other and Gilgamesh has no huge consequence for Laufey.
